# Abundant Corner Counselling

> Virtual therapy practice, with sessions offered virtually across Canada. Tagline: "Move from survival to thriving." Root-cause healing for people who feel stuck in survival mode.

## Therapist
Yeukai Tsikira, Registered Psychotherapist (Qualifying), College of Registered Psychotherapists of Ontario (CRPO) registration 18718; Canadian Certified Counsellor (CCC), Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association (CCPA) member 11246478. EMDR trained. She is not a psychologist.

## Services and fees
- Free 15-minute consultation
- Individual therapy: $120 per 50-minute session
- Family sessions: $180 per 75-minute session
- EMDR sessions: $260 per 90-minute session
- Receipts are provided for insurance benefits; no direct billing yet
- Current promotion: $50 per session for a limited number of spots, locked in for clients who start during the promotion

## Who it serves
Adults, teens age 12 and up, and families. Sessions are virtual, available across Canada — including Edmonton, Saskatoon, Prince Albert, Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Ottawa, Montreal, Winnipeg and Halifax — and in English and French.

## Speaking
Yeukai also speaks at workshops and events. Past engagements include the Grande Prairie Public Library, the Alberta Northwest Palliative Care Society, and Prince Albert SDA Church ("Mental Health and the Great Controversy"). Speaking fees are quoted per event.
